text: Over the years, I've been contacted by many Ward 25 residents concerned about safety for schoolchildren and families on Wanless Avenue and Ranleigh Avenue. In May, I met with Transportation staff and several community members on-site to identify outstanding issues. As a result of this meeting, Transportation Services staff advised that a 30km/h speed limit would be justified on both Wanless Avenue and Ranleigh Avenue due to the close proximity to Bedford Park Public School. For this reason, the proposed speed limit reduction also complies with the Speed Limit Policy adopted by City Council in May 2015. School Safety Zone measures will be installed at Bedford Park Public School by 2019.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Wanless Avenue, between Yonge Street and Wanless Crescent. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Ranleigh Avenue, between Yonge Street and Ronan Avenue.
